EmailTemplate.description: Sales Console - emails the personalised sales offer PDF to the customer. Sent by UnitSearchLwcController.sendSalesOfferPDF.
EmailTemplate.name: SalesConsole_SalesOfferNotification
EmailTemplate.subject: Your Sales Offer from Modon
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in Modon.
Please find your personalised sales offer attached. It sets out the unit details, pricing and the full payment schedule for your review.
If you would like to proceed, or have any questions, please speak to your sales representative or contact us on 800 MODON (80066366) or customercare@modon.com.
We look forward to welcoming you home.
Best regards, Modon Real Estate
